project_type: React Native (Expo) mono-repo with two apps (passenger-app, driver-app) and one Express/TypeScript API gateway
build_system: Each package has its own package.json. API gateway uses tsc for build. Apps use Expo / Metro. No workspace-level build script.
test_framework: API gateway: Jest (`npm test` inside services/api-gateway). Apps: no Jest config found — no automated tests for RN screens.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` in services/api-gateway — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm test` in services/api-gateway — existing tests must still pass. 3. Verify migration file is syntactically valid SQL (psql --single-transaction dry-run if DB is available). 4. Metro bundler: run `npx expo start` in each app and confirm no red-screen import errors (manual step, no CI).
environment_constraints: Never restart the dev server on :9001. DB migrations live under services/api-gateway/migrations/ — last file is 011_payments.sql; next is 012_ratings_earnings.sql (NOT 015 — there is no 012-014 in the repo). The auth middleware sets req.user.id (not req.user.userId as used in the older trips.ts routes) — new routes must use (req as any).user?.id.
contribution_requirements: All new backend routes must be registered via safeUse() in services/api-gateway/src/routes/index.ts. Route files export a default Router. Follow existing pattern: import pool from '../database/connection', use (req as any).user?.id for userId.
key_patterns: Backend: Express Router, pool.query with parameterised $1/$2 placeholders, (req as any).user?.id for auth, safeUse() registration in routes/index.ts. Driver-app: ThemeProvider + useTheme(), react-i18next useTranslation(), DriverAPI service class in src/services/api/DriverAPI.ts, react-navigation stack inside bottom-tabs (HomeStack inside Tab), MainNavigator.tsx for screen registration. Passenger-app: flat NativeStack in App.tsx, screens imported directly, no tab bar. EarningsScreen in passenger-app/screens/ is a stub (hardcoded zeros). EarningsScreen in driver-app/src/screens/main/ is functional but fetches from a /driver/earnings endpoint that does not exist on the real API gateway (it goes through APIClient which points to the gateway).
directory_structure: daladala/ ├── apps/ │   ├── passenger-app/ (Expo, flat stack navigator in App.tsx, screens/ at root) │   └── driver-app/ (Expo, src/ with contexts/ navigation/ screens/ services/ types/) ├── services/ │   └── api-gateway/ (Express+TypeScript, src/routes/, src/middleware/, src/database/, migrations/)
